content: {"episode_id":"ep-05019","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Please reconsider the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) on medical necessity grounds. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or conduction abnormalities that may be precipitating these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion."}
